js: (async () => { const G = window.G, E = G.EULEN, r = E.routes[0], P = G.player; localStorage.removeItem('eulenMarathon'); if (P.car) G.toggleCar(); E.start(r, false, 'lauf', { test: true }); const W = E.run.W, n = Math.min(9, W.length - 2); const roh = W.slice(0, n + 1).map(q => [q[0], q[1]]); const t0 = performance.now(); while (E.run && E.run.i <= n && performance.now() - t0 < 120000) { const [x, z] = E.run.W[E.run.i]; await G.streamInit(x, z); P.pos.set(x, G.TH(x, z), z); if (P.mesh) P.mesh.position.copy(P.pos); await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 350)); } const strasse = q => { let bd = 1e9; for (const s of G.WORLD.roads) { if (!s || !s.p || s.ry || s.mw) continue; for (let i = 0; i < s.p.length - 1; i++) { const ax = s.p[i][0], az = s.p[i][1], dx = s.p[i + 1][0] - ax, dz = s.p[i + 1][1] - az, l2 = dx * dx + dz * dz || 1, t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ((q[0] - ax) * dx + (q[1] - az) * dz) / l2)), d = Math.hypot(ax + dx * t - q[0], az + dz * t - q[1]); if (d < bd) bd = d; } } return bd; }; const out = { punkte: W.length, geprueft: n, erreicht: E.run ? E.run.i - 1 : n, eingerastet: 0, imHaus: 0, maxAbstand: 0, verschoben: [] }; for (let k = 1; k <= n; k++) { const q = W[k]; if (q.str) out.eingerastet++; await G.streamInit(q[0], q[1]); if (G.solidAt(q[0], q[1]) >= 0) out.imHaus++; out.maxAbstand = Math.max(out.maxAbstand, Math.round(strasse(q))); out.verschoben.push(Math.round(Math.hypot(q[0] - roh[k][0], q[1] - roh[k][1]))); } if (E.run) E.stop(); window.__ms = out; return JSON.stringify(out); })()
